'''Jared Lockwood Corellian Regional Report No.2 (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Jared Lockwood]] wrote for the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] fan site about the [[1999 Corellia Regionals]] in Indianapolis.<ref name="cec-rr2">[http://www.oocities.org/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/regionalrep2.html Corellian Regional Report No.2], Jared Lockwood, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities; OoCities mirror). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190202030118/http://www.oocities.org:80/collegepark/plaza/9433/reports/regionalrep2.html Internet Archive]</ref> Lockwood won his first five games and lost the sixth to [[Chad McCory]] by 9, finishing 3rd of 49 with 10 (+96). He played Mind What You Have Learned (first test, Heavy Tech) on the Light side and AT-AT Ops with Decree on the Dark side.

== Other results named in the report ==

* [[Joe Mornout]] (written "Joe Mournout") went into the last round at 8 (+68), won by 45 and took second place, keeping Lockwood out of the final.

== Original report ==

'''Corellian Regional Report No.2'''
* '''Author:''' Jared Lockwood

<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
Jared Lockwood

Hello.  I don't normally write tournament reports, but since this was a big one, I figured, Go For It!  I don't have any funny stories about what happened on the way to the tourny, so I'll keep it simple.
My LS was MWYHL 1st test Heavy Tech.
My DS was AT-AT Ops w/Decree.

Game 1- My LS vs. Brad Kipple's ISB Spaceport Docking Bays. He starts IAO, I start wise advice.  First turn he deploys a couple drain -1 systems and a docking bay and picks up.  I deploy Yoda's Hut, Yoda, and pick up.  He drops Evax to a spaceport docking bay on blizzard 2.  I play a PoS on it and lost Grimtash, get 3 ORS.  I deploy Training Area, get jedi test, and Deploy DoS from hand w/electrobinoculars.  He deploys some people to another DB.  I deploy Epp Han Epp Obi and Chewy to take them, I draw a six he draws a two.  All my characters live thanks to Yoda.  Eventually he flips his objective, but the damage was already done, a couple On the Edges to end it.  Space drains at Coruscant and Kessel save the day.
Win by 21  2(+21)

Game 2- My DS vs.  Jamie Abel's MWYHL-just yoda
He starts with Planet Farthest, I start w/ Surface Defense(Resistance, Secret Plans) I drop my sites, some systems, get Den of Theives out early.  It's evident that his deck is based on one big beatdown to win, so I take it slow.  When I have three ops on the Den, I drop an At-At to each site with some pilots and flip.  He drains me one a Kashyyyk(DS) and one at Lower Corridor.  I'm draining at three sites.  The Big E comes to take care of Captain Han in at Kessel, but I inflict no battle damage.  I eat some uncontrollable fury for about 5 turns.  He's down to 3 life force and I have 12 so he battle's me at Kessel.  I forget to once per game for five during weapons phase(Oops!), and draw my battle destiny.  He loses his remaining life force to the battle damage.
Win by 12 4(+33)

Game 3- My LS vs. John Woollen's HDADTJ Epic Duel
He starts Bad Feelings and I start Insurrection.  We lose from Visage for 2 turns.  He drops the Cantina and Firt Strike.  Next turn he drops Vader and Mosep the Cantina.  I drop EPP Luke and say Bring it On.  He doesn't duel so I battle miss Vader and draw a 3 for battle destiny.  He continues to drain two.  I drop Jeron Webb and Commander Vanden to Holotheatre, and GL on G1 to Coruscant w/Spiral in hand.  Han comes down to Lower Corridor with Narrow Escsape in hand.  A random Off the Edge Reveals a Don't forget the Droids.  I can't find EBinoc's so I track the 6 for the rest of the game.  Random On & Off the Edges go uncontested.  Drains of 9 per turn do the rest.
Win by 30 6(+63)

Game 4- My DS vs. Geoff Snider's  Space Inserts(No HB)
He start Rendevous Point and Battle Plan, I start Corulag, jungle, Surface defense( No There Is No Try)  This game was not very memorable.  He gets Dagobah out and plays Planet Farthest, I drop a ship and 2 pilots at Endor, and an ops and Ds-61-2 to the swamp.  I never see a monnok the entire game.  I get the Big E on the table and continue to drain at sites.  He Grimtashs me for 3 ops and 2 Twi'leks.  Eventually he starts inserting for 2 force a turn.  Ground drains kill him.
Win by 18 8(+81)

Game 5- My LS vs. Frank Lamantia's Drazin AAIghhhhhh!!!!!
He start IAO I start Wise Advise looking for Scans.  He doesn't do much early besides pick up.  I get Leia w/ Binoc's and Yoda set up on Dagobah.  Starts to play Aggghh!!! to make me lose cards.  He sets up Drazin, Vader w/Stick and Evazon at Security Tower. He monnoks every turn.  Eventually I grab Aggghhh!!!  I get space going early with RLonR1 at Kessel.  I get a Grimtash thru and see he only has a Vader's Personal Shuttle in hand.  GLonG1 to Coruscant.  EPP Obi goes to the audience chamber.  He must have played Agghhh!!! 8 or 9 times before I grabbed it.  He didn't drain the entire game.  The final play was Vader getting Clashed and Drazin eating cards from Orrimaarko.
Win by 24 10(+105)

Still undefeated only on other undefeated left.  Next person down has one loss w/ +68.

Game 6- My DS vs. Chad McCory's HB EPP
I start Surface Defense, he starts Wise Advise. My ops get there normal start.  Some sites, I Twi'lek for Security Precautions and draw up Den of Theives.  Second turn he deploys more systems and plays planet farthest, and drops 2 ships to Tatooine.  Two turns later I flip, play a starship to Coruscant and Battle Order.  He summarily flips his Objective and beats me off the system. He also deploys a bunch of EPPs to my sites in an attempt to flip my Obj. back.  He doesn't succeed, but manages to make me pay for my force drains.  I manage to probe on the first attempt and he loses 7 to the Security Precautions.  Late game I drop Executer to Coruscant to try to reestablish Battle Order, but he uses S-Foils and drops 3 X-wings to accompany the 2 already there and I lose Executer to Battle Damage.  He drains me out.  After the game i found that he had gotten all four EPPs in his opening hand(Ouch!)
Lose by 9 10(+96)

After the last game, I learned that Joe Mournout who was 8(+68) going into the last round won by 45!  Now I don't even get to play in the Finals.  Well too bad.  I finished 3rd out of 49.  I guess that will do for this year.  Anyone with questions about Tech can feel free to Email me.
</nowiki></div>
